description: A partner-facing UI that explains our agentic Software Factory and AI Research pipeline, demonstrates trust-building automation, and gives prospective partners clear calls-to-action.

user_personas.name: Strategic Partner Lead
goals: Identify integration points and partnership value
frustrations: High-level pitches with no concrete workflow details
Lack of technical depth for due diligence

user_personas.name: Technical Due-Diligence Lead
frustrations: No visibility into roadmap and support

must_have_features: Clear explanation of discovery → production workflow using the Software Factory
Dynamic timeline/flow visualization with key automation highlights
Section showcasing AI Studio research outcomes and ROI
nice_to_have_features: Interactive filtering (e.g., by partner type or industry)
Embedded video or animation explaining the pipeline
success_criteria: Partners understand our value proposition within 60 seconds
Demo highlights key automation phases with proof points
Conversation requests increase by 25% within 30 days
